compiled_state.title: UPDATE workflow-config-schema.json and test: rename max_resolution_attempts -> max_cycles in review section
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD3: All callers audited: a grep for max_resolution_attempts in .claude/, plugins/dso/, dso_ci_review/ returns zero hits in code files

## Overview
Two changes in concert:
1. Rename the JSON schema property in plugins/dso/docs/workflow-config-schema.json
2. Update the test tests/scripts/test-workflow-config-schema.sh that validates that schema property

## File Impact
- plugins/dso/docs/workflow-config-schema.json: modify (rename property max_resolution_attempts → max_cycles under review.properties)
- tests/scripts/test-workflow-config-schema.sh: modify (update test assertion to check for max_cycles, not max_resolution_attempts)

## Implementation

### workflow-config-schema.json
Current (line 534):
```json
"max_resolution_attempts": {
  "type": "integer",
  "description": "Maximum autonomous fix/defend attempts before escalating to the user. Controls the Autonomous Resolution Loop in REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md, test-failure delegation in COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md and TEST-FAILURE-DISPATCH.md.",
  "minimum": 1,
  "default": 5,
  "examples": [3, 5, 10]
}
```

Change to:
```json
"max_cycles": {
  "type": "integer",
  "description": "Maximum autonomous fix/defend attempts (review cycles) before escalating to the user. Controls the Autonomous Resolution Loop in REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md, test-failure delegation in COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md and TEST-FAILURE-DISPATCH.md. Replaces deprecated key max_resolution_attempts.",
  "minimum": 2,
  "default": 4,
  "examples": [3, 4, 5]
}
```
NOTE: minimum changes from 1 to 2 per epic SC2 ("max_cycles < 2 is rejected at config load"). Default changes from 5 to 4 per epic description.

### test-workflow-config-schema.sh
Update lines 114-136 to check for max_cycles instead of max_resolution_attempts:
- Change 'max_resolution_attempts' → 'max_cycles' in the Python inline script
- Update expected default from 5 to 4
- Update the test_schema_review_section_exists description comment

## TDD Requirement
Update tests/scripts/test-workflow-config-schema.sh FIRST to assert max_cycles is present. Then update the schema. The test will fail RED until the schema is updated.

## Consumer Detection Pass
The schema is consumed by:
- validate-config.sh (which has its own KNOWN_SCALAR_KEYS list — handled in T4)
- Any tooling that validates workflow-config.yaml against this schema
No other code consumers found via grep.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] max_cycles property exists in schema review section
  Verify: python3 -c "import json; d = json.load(open('plugins/dso/docs/workflow-config-schema.json')); props = d['properties']['review']['properties']; assert 'max_cycles' in props, 'max_cycles not found'; print('OK')"
- [ ] max_resolution_attempts property removed from schema
  Verify: python3 -c "import json; d = json.load(open('plugins/dso/docs/workflow-config-schema.json')); props = d.get('properties',{}).get('review',{}).get('properties',{}); assert 'max_resolution_attempts' not in props, 'old key still present'; print('OK')"
- [ ] max_cycles minimum is 2 and default is 4
  Verify: python3 -c "import json; d = json.load(open('plugins/dso/docs/workflow-config-schema.json')); p = d['properties']['review']['properties']['max_cycles']; assert p['minimum']==2 and p['default']==4, f'minimum={p[\"minimum\"]} default={p[\"default\"]}'; print('OK')"
- [ ] Schema test passes
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-workflow-config-schema.sh 2>&1 | tail -1 | grep -qE 'FAILED: 0\b'
- [ ] workflow-config-schema.json is valid JSON
  Verify: python3 -c "import json; json.load(open('plugins/dso/docs/workflow-config-schema.json')); print('valid')"

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
